[SWS_PHM_01349] Switch Elementary Supervision Status from kFAILED to kOK
⌈
If the Elementary Supervision Status is kFAILED AND
there is no failure present in the Alive Supervision, i.e. the counter for failed Alive
Supervision reference cycles is zero, THEN the Platform Health Management
shall change the Elementary Supervision Status to kOK.
⌋
